name: Savoia Hotels
verdict: Under the management and coordination of Nonsolohotel Ltd. (private). Nothing found.
note: Two Bologna hotels (Savoia Hotel Regency and Savoia Hotel Country House). Back-of-shirt sponsor, sixth season of partnership with Virtus when announced in September 2025; the mark sits across the upper back of the 2026/27 home jerseys in the club store's product photos.
